1. A shelf that has no back (open on both sides) will help you stack more. If it can fit in a shallow/long rubber-made container (under the bed storage box) that will help catch any drips.

  2. Jiffy greenhouses are great for starting seeds. Definitely recommend those. Then you can pop the pods in planters. I suggest potting in your tub for easier clean up.

  3. You can get aerogardens. They are little hydroponic grow systems that work well but are usually pretty small scale.

  4. Planning is big! What will you eat, what can fit your space, and how can you preserve stuff? Your seeds come up all at once if you don't stagger them, so plan for canning or freezing. Also maybe a grow lamp for winter. Herbs are easy indoors. Veg is tougher because many plants climb or need lots of space. Also consider your resource use and waste.
